# Quillstone Health — Investor Update, September 2026
> **FICTIONAL TRAINING DATA ROOM.** Quillstone Health, Inc. is an invented company created to practice investment diligence. Every name, number and person here is made up; any resemblance to a real company is a coincidence.

**To:** Existing investors and board observers · **From:** Dana Whitfield, CEO · **Date:** October 6, 2026

## Headlines
- **Record quarter.** ARR ended September at **$15.6M**, with nine new logos signed in the last week of the quarter.
- **Series B process is underway.** We have shared materials with nine firms and expect first partner meetings in November.
- **Cash:** $9.4M at September 30.

## Key numbers
| | August | September |
|---|---|---|
| ARR | $13.4M | $15.6M |
| Customers | 246 | 262 |
| Net burn (month) | $0.99M | $0.90M |
| Headcount | 138 | 141 |

Q3 net burn averaged $0.96M per month, up from $0.83M in Q2 as we added 10 people ahead of the Series B plan. At the Q3 burn rate our runway is roughly 10 months, which is why we intend to close the round by the end of Q1 2027.

## Wins
- Nine new logos in September, led by Pinecrest Health Alliance (our largest new-logo contract this year).
- Brookmere Health System rolled Quillstone out to a second and third entity in its network during the year.
- Cedar Valley Hospital Network expanded to 11 facilities.
- Two annual-prepay renewals converted to three-year terms.

## Challenges
- Implementation capacity is stretched: average go-live time lengthened from 3.5 to 5 weeks.
- Two mid-sized customers churned in Q3 after their EHR vendor bundled a competing module.
- One-time services billing (data migration, custom integrations) was higher than planned in September.

## Metrics we track
ARR growth, enterprise NRR (**128%**), gross margin (**82%**), and burn multiple (**1.4x** on a Q2 basis).

## Asks
1. Introductions to health-system CFOs and CIOs in the Southeast and Texas.
2. Any reference calls you can offer to Series B firms that reach out.
3. Feedback on the $120M pre-money target before the first partner meetings.

*Numbers are preliminary and unaudited.*
